description: A dramatic, minimal product-display vignette set on a highly polished jet-black lacquered surface that creates near-perfect reflections of the three objects above. The background is a deep, dark brown-to-black gradient — a seamless studio backdrop suggesting a moody, intimate atmosphere. Three oblong egg-shaped paper lantern forms in a row occupy the center of the frame: the left one in deep chocolate brown-black, the center one in vivid saturated tangerine orange, and the right one in crisp white. Each sits on slender matte black tripod wire legs. The orange central form is the largest and most prominent, dominating the composition. The warm glows from the three sources pool on the black lacquer surface as three distinct warm amber reflections beneath each form. The overall effect is graphic, theatrical, and gallery-like — reminiscent of a high-design object display. Camera is at a low-to-seated eye-level, roughly 2–3 feet high, normal-to-wide lens, in a centered symmetrical composition looking slightly upward toward the three forms against the dark background. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
